This is compared with the theoretical maximum of 387 Wh/kg[2] for LIB technology. So the full cell's energy density is slightly above the theoretical maximum of LiCoO2/graphite cells. The paper says this far surpasses recent SIB reports, which reach only ∼200 Wh/kg[3] with respect to active mass.[4][5][6]
